scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Rueda de Casino originated in Havana, Cuba, in the early 1950s, first danced at Club Casino Deportivo around 1956.
It developed from Cuban Urban Son, Cha Cha Cha, Mambo, and Rumba Guaguancó.
The circular group dance with partner swapping was called 'Rueda del Casino' and became popular in Havana clubs and on television by the late 1970s.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Couples form a circle (rueda) holding closed dance position.
A caller (líder) inside the circle calls out moves, which the dancers execute simultaneously.
Moves include partner swaps and turns, often accompanied by hand signals.
Watch for Dame, Enchufla, Vacila.

scenes.title: Listen
narration: Rueda de Casino is danced to Cuban Son montuno, guaracha, and later salsa and timba music.
The tempo is typically salsa tempo but exact BPM is not specified.
Listen for the congas, bongos, timbales, trumpets.
The pulse is 4/4.

scenes.title: The costume and the setting
narration: Danced socially in clubs, dance studios, and outdoor venues.
Traditional Cuban dancers sometimes wear white clothing, especially older groups in Havana.
The dance circle can vary in size from two couples to large groups forming concentric circles.
on_screen: Images — MISSING

scenes.title: The people
narration: Rene Gueits, founder of Salsa Lovers in Miami (1994), structured the Miami style of Rueda de Casino, modifying the original Cuban style by removing Afro-Cuban elements.
Cuban dancers and groups on the island and abroad have preserved and shared the original style.
Two main styles: original Cuban style with Afro-Cuban improvisation and Miami style with disco influences and structured choreography.
Descended from Cuban Urban Son and Cha Cha Cha, incorporating partner turns from Mambo and Rumba Guaguancó.

scenes.title: Family tree
narration: Rueda de Casino is parent of Salsa (Cuban style): Rueda de Casino evolved from Cuban salsa and son montuno dance forms.
Rueda de Casino is shares music of Timba: Timba music is a common accompaniment for Rueda de Casino.
Rueda de Casino is variant of Rueda de Bachata: A rueda-style dance adapted to bachata music, originating in Boston.
Rueda de Casino is variant of Swing Rueda: A rueda format applied to swing dance.
